theorem probe_yes_no_disjoint (I : GapCVP.Comparator.Instance)
    (h1 : GapCVP.Comparator.gapYES400 I = true)
    (h2 : GapCVP.Comparator.gapNO400 I = true) : False := by
  simp only [GapCVP.Comparator.gapYES400, GapCVP.Comparator.gapNO400,
    GapCVP.Comparator.wellFormed, decide_eq_true_eq] at h1 h2
  obtain ⟨⟨hd, hdet, hr⟩, v, hv⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h2
  have hf : 1 ≤ GapCVP.Comparator.gapFactor400 I := by
    unfold GapCVP.Comparator.gapFactor400
    apply Real.one_le_rpow
    · exact Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hd
    · norm_num
  have hr' : (0:ℝ) < (I.radius : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have h4 := h v
  have h5 : (I.radius : ℝ) ≤ GapCVP.Comparator.gapFactor400 I * (I.radius : ℝ) := by nlinarith
  have h3 : (I.radius : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (GapCVP.Comparator.gapFactor400 I * (I.radius : ℝ)) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hr') h5 2
  linarith
